selection_policy: reachable source-defined computational functions; exclude main and I/O
code_summary: Activity-recognition pipeline. ACCEL_singleSample obtains one sample; acquire_window fills a sample window; transform thresholds noise; featurize computes mean and standard-deviation features; classify compares those features with trained models; record_stats accumulates class counts; warmup_sensor discards startup samples; train builds class models; recognize runs the inference pipeline; sqrt16 computes integer square root. The benchmark driver main is frozen.
